name: PM Schools for Rising India
description: Centrally sponsored scheme to upgrade more than 14,500 schools into exemplar schools showcasing National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 pedagogy, modern STEM facilities, smart classrooms, and holistic student development.
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
target_beneficiaries: Students enrolled in government elementary, secondary, and senior secondary schools
benefits: State-of-the-art smart learning environment, experiential learning pedagogical materials, ICT laboratories, vocational skill hubs, and modern sports infrastructure across upgraded schools.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India.
Centrally sponsored education enhancement scheme covering government schools nationwide.
All students enrolled in designated government schools across primary, upper primary, secondary, and higher secondary grades.
Provision of modern ICT smart classrooms, NEP-aligned curricula, green school facilities, and vocational training.
Official scheme portal and school selection portal at pmshri.education.gov.in.
Over 10,000 schools actively selected and funded across States and Union Territories.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Beneficiary must be an actively enrolled student in a government school selected under PM-SHRI.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card / APAAR ID
required_documents.description: Student Aadhaar or APAAR (Automated Permanent Academic Account Registry) ID.

required_documents.title: School Enrolment / Bonafide Certificate
required_documents.description: Proof of active regular enrolment in the designated PM-SHRI school.
